To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of functional fillers to ZnO filled SiR composite material can enhance the functional behaviors of the materials, but at the same time it also deteriorates the stress grading performance.
the functional behavior of the FGM is strongly dependent on the type and amount of functional fillers used.

the addition of functional fillers to the ZnO filled SiR composite material improves the functional properties, and the material with the highest concentration of functional fillers shows the best performance with respect to the functional properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the functional behaviors of the FGMs, which are essential for the industrial applications.
the development of electric field grading materials with improved functional properties.
the development and evaluation of novel FGM for high voltage applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ZnO-SiR composite material compositions with functional fillers can be used for stress grading applications, but with some limitations.

all the six material compositions are suitable for stress grading applications, however, the material composition with 1.5 wt.% of ZnO, 2 wt.% of SiC, 1 wt.% of Al2O3 and 0.5 wt.% TiO2 shows the best overall performance in terms of functional properties.
all six material compositions have the potential to be used as stress grading materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the material compositions with higher ZnO content (30 wt. %) are suitable for industrial applications.

ZnO filled SiR composite with 1% of functional fillers, namely, 0.5% of nano-silver and 0.5 % of nano-titanium dioxide, can be used for industrial applications, where the electric field is critical, e.g. cable termination, joints, rotating machines, etc.
ZnO filled SiR composite materials with functional additives are promising materials for stress grading applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the material composition can be optimized to achieve the best functional properties and the stress grading performance.
the use of functional fillers in FGM is an effective way to achieve a desired combination of several properties.
a material composition with suitable functional fillers can be designed to satisfy the requirements of different industrial applications.
